blocks.text:
The
border-color property is used to set the color of the four borders.
The color can be set by:

items: name - specify a color name, like "red"
HEX - specify a HEX value, like "#ff0000"
RGB - specify a RGB value, like "rgb(255,0,0)"
HSL - specify a HSL value, like "hsl(0, 100%, 50%)"

blocks.text:
Note: If
border-color is not set, it inherits the color of the element.

blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text:
The
border-color property can have from one to four values (for
the top border, right border, bottom border, and the left border).
